description: F254 — the known-dead model list Remedy ships. Operator-maintained DATA, not discovery: Remedy never probes a provider or calls the network to build or refresh it, so the dead-model check is exactly as fresh as this file. Extend it with the doctor.dead_models config key; config only ADDS, it never replaces these entries.
